book.name: PILIPAI
book.title: ME PILIPAI ꞌIDI LETA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Lokagutoki
ꞌAboꞌagu ta Timoti maꞌiyagu ꞌaguiguinuwa Toꞌetoseyana Yesu manuna, ꞌimi leta ꞌaꞌetoladinawa ꞌomi me Pilipai Yesu Keliso ꞌina toekalesiyao, be wate ꞌimi toanuganao be ꞌimi dikoniyao maꞌemiyao.
Tamada Yaubada ta ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso ꞌidi obobomega wada miya gwausowala.
Paulo ꞌina sidasida me Pilipai manudi
Tuta yauna Yaubada ꞌena yalokagutoki, ꞌabo tuta nina yanuwami,
ta ma igu gwausowala manumi ꞌigu sidasidao ꞌediya,
be ma igu lokagutoki ꞌama lemao ꞌemiyega ꞌalobalobadi, tetela boboꞌana ꞌana simanaꞌunuyega ga batuwa.
Wate ma igu emisa ꞌaene Yaubada ꞌina guinuwa boboꞌadi niꞌatu ꞌemiya ꞌieꞌalena be tauna ꞌida losaloni, maꞌetamo Yesu Keliso ꞌina ꞌasiyata sinabwana ꞌenaya.

Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌilobwenena be manumi toꞌase yalotolotoona nadigega, manuna ꞌomi nuwagu waꞌewena, manuna ꞌomi maꞌegwao Yaubada ꞌilemelemeda gete tuga deliya yamiyamiya, ta ꞌilemelemeda wate tetela boboꞌana ꞌana eꞌita be ꞌana ꞌebe ewaiwai ꞌediya.
Yaubada wate ꞌimwalatonigu ꞌaene Yesu Keliso ꞌina obobomega nuwanuwagu ꞌomi,
ta ma igu sidasida manumi be ꞌaene ꞌimi eobooboboma ꞌisinasinabwa, ma imi sinasinapu be ma imi mwalatoi,
be ꞌenega yage boboꞌadi wada esinuwedi, be Keliso ꞌina ꞌasiyata maꞌetamo ꞌenaya adelimi boboꞌami ta ꞌesasemi,
ta ma imi guinuwa boboꞌadi Yesu Keliso ꞌina waiwaiyega, manudi tomota Yaubada sida tupui be sida ꞌawa eseese.
Paulo ꞌina ꞌatetagwala Keliso ꞌenaya
Gosegwao, nuwanuwagu be wada mwalatoni ꞌaene mwau nidi niꞌatu yalobedi ꞌediyega tetela boboꞌana ꞌiꞌelelewana tomota yaudi ꞌediya,
ꞌenega sena gete ꞌenaya Sisa ꞌina tolosaiyao be tomota maiboꞌadi niꞌatu sinonona ꞌaene Keliso manuna sisaꞌugu deliya.
Ta wate tasidao yaudi ꞌigu miya deliya siꞌitena, ꞌenega sietaetapewa ꞌInapwana ꞌina guinuwa ꞌena, ta Yaubada ꞌina ona sisimasimane ma idi ꞌatepatu.
ꞌAina tologuguyao eꞌipiꞌipiyega siloguloguguya Keliso manuna, ta ꞌaidi wate obobomega siloguloguguya,
taudi siobobomegu ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu deliya yamiyami tetela boboꞌana ꞌana eꞌita manuna,
ta esi toeꞌipiꞌipi nidi nuwanuwadi be sigienuwa mwauyegu gete tuga deliya yamiyami, ꞌenega ꞌidi kaboega Keliso tetelina siguguyae taudimo ꞌidi gilagata manuna.
Ta tuwa tuga Keliso nina tetelina ꞌana loguguya yauna manuna yagwaugwausowala, ꞌeguma kaboega nai onaꞌaiꞌailega.
Ta wate yada gwausowala, manuna yamwalamwalatoni ꞌaene Yesu Keliso yaluyaluwana ꞌina lema ꞌenega, be ꞌimi sidasidao manugu ꞌediyega, sida liꞌamigu miyamwau gete ꞌenega.

Wate ꞌaboꞌagu ma igu emisa ta ma igu nuwayaina ꞌaene geyaꞌabo yaomayamaya, ta esi yanuwayaina ꞌaene ma igu ꞌatepatu gete tuga ta tuta yauna Keliso ꞌana esana yada giesinabwa, nai ꞌigu miya baleꞌu mayawasigu ꞌenega, nai ꞌigu mwawasa ꞌenega.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌigu miya baleꞌuya nate Keliso maꞌiyagu, ta esi ꞌigu mwawasa ꞌenaya loeposeyana Keliso ꞌenega yalobai.
ꞌEguma baleꞌuya yamiyami ꞌigu guinuwao boboꞌadi Keliso manuna siapweapwesa, ꞌenega nigeya yamwalamwalatoni toꞌase nuwanuwagu be yaesinuwe.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, yage ꞌeluwa ꞌediyega ꞌadi esinuwa ꞌeguya mwau wawasae. Nuwanuwagu be baleꞌu gete yapilisine be Keliso maꞌiyagu ꞌamimi, nate ꞌebe gwausowala sinabwana.
Ta esi ꞌilobwenegu be baleꞌuya yada miyami be ꞌenega yada lemelememi.
ꞌEnega yamwalatoi ꞌaiꞌailina ꞌaene ꞌomi maꞌegwao tada miyami be yada lememi be wada gwausowala ꞌimi emisa Keliso ꞌena manuna,
be wate ꞌigu ayausa limana ꞌemiya manuna wada gwausowala sinabwana, nate Yesu Keliso ꞌina lema ꞌedaya manuna.

Ta wada ꞌitaꞌiꞌisimi ꞌaene ꞌimi guinuwao ꞌediyega tomota Keliso tetelina sida ꞌawaboboꞌane, ꞌenega ꞌeguma yayausimi, nai ꞌeguma yamiyaila, tuwa tuga tetelimi boboꞌana yada noono ꞌaene ma imi ꞌatetagwala watoolo paꞌala, ta ma imi nuwanuwa leleleya ga ꞌenega waetaetapewa tetela boboꞌana ꞌana emisa manuna,
ta geyaꞌabo wate wamatamatauta ꞌami talauwalao ꞌediya. Gete manuna taudi sida mwalatoi ꞌaiꞌaili ꞌaene sida esilae, be ꞌomi ꞌami ꞌetoseyana wada loba Yaubada ꞌenega.
Manuna Yaubada niꞌatu ꞌitagwala ꞌemiya be Keliso ꞌena waemiemisa, be tauna wate manuna wada ꞌelouya,
nadigega ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌigu losaiya Keliso manuna be ꞌigu ꞌelouyao waꞌitedi, ta gete tuga wanonodi, ta ꞌomi wate ꞌimi losaiya be ꞌimi ꞌelouyao nadigega walobaꞌesedi.
